{{Top|leg}}
A '''symmetric cloud-vee formation''' was a tactic employed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]]. It was used by an [[Elomin task force]] during its [[Destruction of the Elomin task force|engagement]] with the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].
